guide_processing_facts: The total/core/halo products are scalar electron temperatures from corrected distributions.
Core density uses interpolated ion charge density minus halo density; it is not independent quasi-neutrality evidence.
Spacecraft-potential/photoelectron corrections and some scattered-light interpolation are part of archive processing.
Core timestamp centers a2-minute spectrum; appropriate halo time is approximately30seconds later.
remaining_evidence: An authentic in-period electron distribution/moment product with processing and uncertainty provenance, or explicit missing thermal input; no May-to-October interpolation.
